findings_aggregated_for_sde.desc: [AI-SAST via Code Scan Verification Validation | claude-opus-5] Framing is denied outright, matching the CM's 'Deny framing' configuration. SecurityHeadersMiddleware in app/init_app.py:26-30 sets 'X-Frame-Options: DENY' and 'Content-Security-Policy: default-src self; frame-ancestors none' on every response, so both the legacy and the modern control are present rather than one substituting for the other. Registration order is load-bearing and correct: the middleware is added last in init_app(), making it the outermost Starlette layer, so replies short-circuited by the inner TrustedHost (400) and BodySizeLimit (413/400) layers still carry the headers on the way out. No frame-busting JavaScript is relied upon. Alternative mitigation accepted: response-header enforcement applied globally at the outermost middleware layer is the current best practice the CM names | verdict=pass confidence=high
